curatedMovie.curiosityHook: When a routine trip an hour into the past puts a man face-to-face with himself, every fix unleashes fresh chaos.
curatedMovie.description: After accidentally traveling nearly an hour into the past, a man’s discovery of himself leads to unforeseen disasters.
curatedMovie.vibeSummary: Fast-paced, suspenseful, and intellectually demanding, this lean Spanish thriller rewards undivided attention.
curatedMovie.whyWatch: This science-fiction thriller turns an accidental trip into the past into a chain of unforeseeable consequences.
